assets.cover: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: a finished premium GitHub README cover image for TradeFlow, an open-source trade-sales workflow prototype. Generate one exceptionally polished wide landscape cover, approximately 2.1:1 aspect ratio, high resolution. Style: restrained enterprise editorial design, deep forest green and off-white, subtle fine grid, dimensional precision, spacious Swiss typography. Audience: B2B business owners and software architects. Make it visually sophisticated and substantial, never neon, cyberpunk or cartoon. Left half: very large perfectly spelled title 'TradeFlow'. Subtitle on two lines: 'From inquiry to' and 'a verified sales workflow.' Smaller supporting line: 'Customer context. Verified supply. Controlled pricing.' On the right: a refined flowing isometric network of exactly four labeled stages, 'QUALIFY', 'VERIFY', 'NEGOTIATE', 'HAND OFF', connected with fine paths, translucent panels, document and inventory metaphors, suggesting disciplined coordination rather than a chatbot. The final human decision point uses a subtle warm accent. Bottom small text: 'OPEN SOURCE' and 'INTERACTIVE PROTOTYPE'. No Harbor name. No platform or framework logos. No fake stars, performance metrics, customers, deployment badges or extra text. All copy must be sharp and exactly legible, with generous padding. This is a standalone finished image, not a screenshot of a README.
assets.workflow: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset: a high-resolution landscape workflow graphic for the TradeFlow open-source README. Produce a finished meticulous enterprise infographic, 16:10, warm off-white background, forest-green typography, sage panels, amber only for approval, refined typography and uncluttered routing. Visually sophisticated layered system, not a cartoon. Title exactly 'TradeFlow workflow'. Subtitle 'From customer inquiry to a verified sales decision'. Main row exactly six numbered connected cards, with short readable text only: '01 Qualify demand' / 'Specifications, budget, delivery'; '02 Match supply' / 'Internal stock + supplier offers'; '03 Human verification' / 'Availability, quantity, cost'; '04 Quote' / 'Sales-confirmed price / Up to 48 hours'; '05 Negotiate' / 'Concessions within authority'; '06 Human handoff' / 'Orders, reservation, payment'. Arrow order must be 01 → 02 → 03 → 04 → 05 → 06. Below card02, a branch card 'Historical demand' with 'No stock: retain the request' and 'New supply: reconfirm interest', arrows from Match to this card and back into Match. Below card05, branch card 'Supervisor approval' with 'Approve or reject with a reason', arrow from Negotiate to approval and from approval to Human handoff. A bottom continuous evidence rail labeled 'Audit + business memory' with 'Verification • Quote revisions • Concessions • Approvals • Outcomes'. Clearly visible bottom note 'Browser-local simulation · Preset English dialogue · No live channel delivery'. No extra invented nodes, no autonomous payments, no AI stock guarantee. All text must be perfectly legible. Use flat crisp diagram panels with subtle material depth, ample whitespace, precise geometry, and no crossing arrows through text.
assets.architecture: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset: a finished high-resolution TradeFlow architecture image for an open-source README. Landscape 3:2. Professional enterprise system diagram, rich visual hierarchy, off-white, deep forest green, sage and small warm amber accents, precise diagram lines, readable typography and spacious modular composition. Title 'TradeFlow architecture'. Subtitle 'Business authority separate from Agent execution'. Important: distinguish actual code and browser simulation from future designs; do not claim a deployed microservices platform. Left two-thirds labeled 'CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION'. At top two large side-by-side panels, 'Browser workbench' with short chips 'Mock CRM', 'SOP', 'Quotes', 'Approval simulation', 'Local state'; and 'Local HTTP prototype' with 'Fixed demo identity', 'Customer ownership', 'Audit transactions'. Label between them 'Separate prototypes' and DO NOT draw any line connecting UI directly to API. Arrows from both down to one strong shared panel 'Business domain engine' containing 'Matching', 'Verification', 'Integer money', 'Profit floor', 'Expiry', 'Send guards'. Below it a 'PGlite + SQL migrations' panel labeled 'Local development persistence'. Right third labeled 'CONTRACTS + PLANNED EXTENSIONS', enclosed by a clear dashed boundary. Include five concise dashed panels: 'AgentRuntime interface' with 'start / resume / interrupt'; 'Model + tools' with 'Execution adapter / SOP retrieval'; 'Channel delivery' with 'WhatsApp / Validated message drafts'; 'Operations' with 'Durable jobs / Production identity'; 'ERP + order sync'. All extension edges dashed and explicitly future. Legend at bottom exactly 'Solid: code or simulation  |  Dashed: interface or planned integration'. Second bottom note 'No live LLM, WhatsApp or ERP connection today'. Use restrained layered architectural sophistication without false infrastructure or unexplained service logos. No Harbor or Codex branding. All labels must be clearly spelled and readable.
